# Version 1.0

✨ New Features ✨
Modded NPC Support
- Characters added by other mods (such as Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, etc.) are now detected automatically.
- No hardcoded character list is required.

 JPEG Support
- Photos can now use `.jpg` and `.jpeg` formats in addition to `.png`.

Configurable Hotkey
- The album can now be opened with a fully customizable keybind (default: **F8**).
- Supports multi-key combinations through SMAPI's `KeybindList`.

 Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Integration
- If Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, the hotkey can be changed directly from the in-game settings menu.
- No need to manually edit `config.json`.

New "Heart Album" Item
A new in-game item has been added.
- Automatically given to the player on the first day of a new save.
- Can also be purchased from **Pierre's General Store** for **250g**.
- Using the item (right-click / action button while holding it) opens the album, just like the hotkey.

 New Photo Notifications
- When a friendship level unlocks a new photo, the game now:
  - Displays a HUD notification.
  - Plays a notification sound.
- Players no longer need to manually open the album to discover newly unlocked photos.

NEW Indicators
- Unseen unlocked photos are marked with a **"NEW!"** label.
- Indicators appear:
  - In the character list.
  - Next to each character's photo counter.
- Based on per-save viewing history.

Fullscreen Photo Viewer
- Clicking a photo opens it in fullscreen.
- Browse between photos without leaving fullscreen using:
  - On-screen arrows
  - Keyboard arrow keys
  - Mouse wheel
  - Gamepad controls
- Close the viewer with:
  - The close button
  - **Esc**

 Sortable Gallery
- Character list can be sorted by:
  - Alphabetical order
  - Friendship hearts
- Sorting can be toggled with a dedicated button.

Gamepad / Controller Support
Full controller navigation is now available, including:
- D-pad navigation
- Trigger support
- A / B / Y buttons
- Character browsing
- Photo browsing
- Sorting controls
- Fullscreen navigation
---
🎨 Visual & UX Improvements 🎨
 Redesigned Menu
- Larger interface (**1200×800**).
- More spacing for improved readability and navigation.

Improved Friendship Display
- Real heart icons (matching Stardew Valley's friendship UI) replace the previous text-based asterisks.

 Character Thumbnails
- Each character now displays a thumbnail using their first unlocked photo.

Polaroid-Style Photos
- Photos are displayed inside a polaroid-style frame.
- Includes:
  - Drop shadow
  - Subtle randomized rotation for a more natural appearance

Smooth Photo Transitions
- Switching photos now features smooth fade and slide animations.

 First-Time Viewing Effect
- Newly unlocked photos display a golden flash effect the first time they are viewed.

Seasonal Background
- The album background now changes its color tint based on the current in-game season.

Overall Progress Counter
- The top of the album now displays your collection progress.

Improved Hover Feedback
- Character rows are highlighted when the cursor hovers over them.

Better Text Layout
- All locked, empty, and error messages now use properly centered, automatically measured text.
- Prevents overflow regardless of screen resolution or string length.[/b][/spoiler]

[b][color=#dbb0a7][size=6]How It Works:[/size][/color]
[/b]Images are loaded automatically from the [b]assets[/b] folder.

They must follow this naming format:
NPCName_01.png
NPCName_02.png
NPCName_03.png

Example:
Abigail_01.png
Abigail_02.png
Abigail_03.png

If a character reaches [b]10 hearts[/b], [b]all remaining images unlock[/b], even if there are more than ten.

[size=5]EXTRA INFO TO READ:[/size][/color]
[/b]♦[b]This mod just adds the album[/b] and some example meme photos in the assets folder so you can see how it works.

♦So far, [b]only PNG files can be loaded[/b]. I might put more features in the mod if it gets loved.

♦In order for the characters to appear in the Album, [b]you must have AT LEAST one 01 image[/b]. That means if you have Sebastian images from 4 to 10 but you don't have Sebastian_01, his name won't appear.

♦There are some features that I think I can add to the mod, but that will depend on the interest of the community.
